Package es.uib.lotery.packet

Class PacketUtils

java.lang.Object
es.uib.lotery.packet.PacketUtils
public class PacketUtils extends Object
Utility class for encoding and decoding primitive data types and strings into and from ByteBuffer objects.

Provides methods for reading and writing byte, int, long, boolean, and String values in a consistent serialization format.

Usage example:


 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(256);
 PacketUtils.putInt(buffer, 42);
 buffer.flip();
 int value = PacketUtils.getInt(buffer);
